before: Compile the Story in the Toolkit once: the Overload, Temperance and Shared Heart goals changed during the build.
Use a NEW Resonant. A character from an older save already learned the eight emotions as separate spells.
Console edition unless a test says PC. Read results in the combat log and on the status tooltips.
Some texts of growing dice still say 1d4 (text pass ARC-0006): judge the dice by the combat log, not the tooltip.
nothere: Releases per day (V7) and feelings at release on a boss (V6) are balance metrics: they run in ARC-0010.

sessions.name: Level 1
sessions.setup: A new Resonant at level 1, one ally, a normal fight against two or three enemies.

tests.expected: One button. Joy, Trust and Fear can be cast; the other five are greyed out or missing.
tests.fails: Eight separate buttons, all eight castable, or the container opens empty.
tests.planb: Grant each emotion in the level lists again and keep the container for the hotbar only.
tests.steps: Open the Weave Surge button on the hotbar.
tests.title: Weave Surge opens with the emotions you know

tests.expected: Castable as a Bonus Action while Overloaded, with no spell slot spent. Only one version of it shows.
tests.fails: It asks for a slot, cannot be cast while Overloaded, or several level versions show.
tests.steps: Cast Surges until the Overload meter reaches 100%. Open Emotional Overload.
tests.title: Emotional Overload is free

tests.expected: You can still cast spells. 1d4 Psychic at the start of your turn. -1 to Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves.
tests.fails: You are silenced, take no damage, or the save penalty is missing.
tests.steps: With the meter full, check the Overloaded status, then cast spells and wait for your next turn.
tests.title: Overloaded is a trade, not a silence

tests.expected: The first deals an extra 1d4 Psychic; the second deals none. The next turn it works again.
tests.fails: No extra damage, or extra damage on both Surges.
tests.steps: While Overloaded, land a Surge on an enemy (it fails its save), then land a second Surge the same turn.
tests.title: The Surge rider, once per turn

tests.expected: Failed save: Psychic damage per feeling, the enemy dances for 1 turn, Mental Fatigue shows. Made save: half damage, no dance, Mental Fatigue shows. Either way the feelings are gone, Overloaded ends and the meter empties.
tests.fails: Paralysis, no Mental Fatigue, or the meter stays full.
tests.steps: Braid a feeling on an enemy, then release Emotional Overload on it. Repeat on an enemy that makes the save.
tests.title: Emotional Overload, rank I

tests.expected: No dance. The feelings' damage and Mental Fatigue still land.
tests.fails: It dances.
tests.steps: Release Emotional Overload on an enemy immune to Charmed that fails the save.
tests.title: Charm-immune creatures don't dance

tests.expected: After the first: about half the %. After the second: Overloaded is gone and the meter shows about 50%.
tests.fails: The meter keeps its value, empties, or Overloaded keeps going after the fight.
tests.steps: End one fight with the meter partly full (note the %). End another fight while Overloaded.
tests.title: When a fight ends, the meter settles to half

tests.expected: The cantrip damage plus 1d4 Psychic per feeling (combat log). The target's mood does not get longer.
tests.fails: No extra damage per feeling.
tests.steps: Cast Heartstring on an enemy carrying one or two feelings.
tests.title: Heartstring reads feelings

tests.expected: The tooltip lists what each emotion would make of it, with the level that unlocks it.
tests.fails: No list.
tests.steps: Hover a mood on any creature (for example Serene).
tests.title: Moods say what they react with

tests.expected: None.
tests.fails: One or more per fight.
tests.steps: Over your fights at levels 1 to 3, count turns where the Resonant had nothing useful to do.
tests.title: Nothing-to-do turns (levels 1-3)

sessions.name: Levels 2-3
sessions.setup: The same Resonant at level 2, then 3.

tests.expected: Temper is granted, and Anticipation opens inside Weave Surge.
tests.fails: Either arrives at level 3.
tests.steps: Level up to 2.
tests.title: Temper and Anticipation at level 2

tests.expected: The Opposites passive shows and Catharsis happens. With Tier I awake, Catharsis gets +1d8 and moods still last 5 turns (not 7).
tests.fails: No Opposites passive, or moods last 7 turns with Tier I.
tests.steps: Level up to 3. Pour Joy into a Pensive enemy. Wake Tier I in a fight and let a peak fade.
tests.title: Opposites and Tier I at level 3

sessions.name: Levels 5-6
sessions.setup: The Resonant at level 5, then 6, a fight with several enemies and one ally.

tests.expected: After the Temper replay: no Bored. After the normal Disgust: Bored appears.
tests.fails: Bored comes back after the replay, or a normal Disgust stops leaving Bored.
tests.planb: The replay marker clears at the start of the Resonant's next turn instead.
tests.steps: Land Disgust on an enemy and let it fade into Bored. Cast Temper on it (it fails the save). Wait until the replayed Disgust ends. Later, land a normal Disgust again and let it fade.
tests.title: Temper's replay leaves no mood

tests.expected: Not possible: it has no mood until a new Disgust lands.
tests.fails: Temper locks it again with no new Surge.
tests.steps: Right after B1, try to Temper the same enemy again on your next turn.
tests.title: No Temper lock

tests.expected: It takes two enemies.
tests.fails: Still one target.
tests.steps: At level 5, fill the meter and release Emotional Overload.
tests.title: Emotional Overload, rank II

tests.expected: 2d4 Psychic per turn and -2 to Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves; the rider deals 2d4.
tests.fails: Still 1d4 or -1.
tests.steps: At level 5, get Overloaded.
tests.title: Overloaded grows at 5

tests.expected: The Deeper Feelings passive shows. Apprehensive subtracts 1d6 (combat log).
tests.fails: No passive, or still 1d4.
tests.steps: Level up to 5. Land Fear on an enemy and let it fade into Apprehensive; have it make a Wisdom save.
tests.title: Deeper Feelings at 5

tests.expected: Record what happens: if it fails that save, does it take 1d4 Psychic ('Psychic Discharge') and lose Mental Fatigue?
tests.fails: Nothing fails here: write down what you saw. The Owner decides.
tests.steps: At level 5+, release Emotional Overload on an enemy that fails: it dances and has Mental Fatigue (5+ turns). At its turn start it rolls a Wisdom save to stop dancing.
tests.title: Does the dance's save discharge Mental Fatigue?

tests.expected: Level 5: a plain Joy peak. Level 6: Guilt.
tests.fails: Guilt at level 5.
tests.steps: At level 5, pour Joy into an Apprehensive enemy. Level up to 6 and repeat.
tests.title: Complex Feelings at 6, not 5

tests.expected: Hope adds 1d6.
tests.fails: It adds 1d4 (the map reads the ally's level).
tests.planb: One status version per level band, chosen in the Surge.
tests.steps: At level 6, braid Hope on a lower-level ally and watch its next attack roll.
tests.title: Growing dice read the Resonant's level

sessions.name: Level 7
sessions.setup: The Resonant at level 7 with Tier II reachable (6 reactions), one ally, a fight long enough to wake it.

tests.expected: The second Ecstasy / Amazement on the same creature lands as a plain peak. When Ecstasy ends it leaves no mood.
tests.fails: The same creature gets Ecstasy or Amazement twice in one fight.
tests.steps: Joy on an ally, let it fade into Serene, Joy again: Ecstasy. Give it Serene again (a new Joy that fades) and pour Joy a third time. Do the same with Surprise on an enemy (Amazement).
tests.title: Excess once per fight

tests.expected: The first costs no action and its mood shows at once; the second costs your action and can react with it.
tests.fails: The first Surge through the container costs an action.
tests.steps: Wake Tier II. On your turn, cast an emotion through the Weave Surge container, then another one.
tests.title: Tier II's free Surge through the container

tests.expected: Sometimes held, sometimes released.
tests.fails: Always released at once, or never released.
tests.steps: Over a few fights, note whether you held Overloaded for a turn or two or released it at once.
tests.title: Ride or release (levels 3 and 7)

sessions.name: Levels 9-10
sessions.setup: The Resonant at level 9, then 10, a fight with a group of enemies close together and two allies.

tests.expected: Every enemy within 9 m of the point rolls the save and takes its effect.
tests.fails: Only one or two targets.
tests.planb: A separate area spell for rank III, granted at level 9.
tests.steps: At level 9, release Emotional Overload on an enemy in a group.
tests.title: Emotional Overload, rank III (the area)

tests.expected: Each ally gets at most one extra action (Ecstasy) per fight.
tests.fails: An ally gets Ecstasy on two turns.
tests.steps: Emotional Contagion on a Serene ally, wake Tier II, then pour Joy into the Serene allies each turn.
tests.title: Contagion + Tier II: no mass action loop

tests.expected: Deeper Feelings shows again. Hope 1d8; Overloaded 3d4 and -3; Catharsis 4d8.
tests.fails: The old values.
tests.steps: Level up to 9. Check Hope on an ally, Overloaded and Catharsis.
tests.title: Growth at 9

tests.expected: Compassion casts Trust as a plain peak: no Submission, no Prone.
tests.fails: The ally is knocked Prone.
tests.steps: At level 10, ready Compassion. Let an Apprehensive ally take damage from an enemy.
tests.title: Compassion is kind

sessions.name: Levels 11-12
sessions.setup: The Resonant at level 11, then 12, a long fight with the whole party.

tests.expected: Every linked creature feels Joy now and is Serene when it fades. The meter does not rise from it.
tests.fails: Nothing on cast, or the Overload fills from the Joy.
tests.steps: Cast Shared Heart with the party within 18 m.
tests.title: Shared Heart acts on cast

tests.expected: Love reaches every linked ally; the hindering feeling stays on the one you targeted.
tests.fails: The hindering feeling spreads.
tests.steps: With the link up, braid Love on one ally, then braid a hindering feeling on another ally by hand.
tests.title: Shared Heart shares only helpful feelings

tests.expected: The meter fills at once and you are Overloaded. The enemy dances for 2 turns.
tests.fails: The meter stays as it was, or the dance lasts 1 turn.
tests.steps: At level 12, wake Tier III (15 reactions) with the meter not full. Release Emotional Overload on an enemy that fails.
tests.title: Tier III: the dam breaks

tests.expected: Every level except 4 and 8 brings something you can name.
tests.fails: A level you can't name.
tests.steps: Level a Resonant from 1 to 12 and name what changed at each level.
tests.title: Every level-up has something

sessions.name: PC edition (Script Extender)
sessions.setup: A Resonant at level 5 in the PC edition with the deck on.

tests.expected: One Weave Surge card with 24 copies at level 5 (9 at level 1); no separate emotion cards; it is often in hand.
tests.fails: Eight emotion cards, 3 copies, or rarely in hand.
tests.steps: Check the deck list (!arcanapool). Play a few fights.
tests.title: Weave Surge in the deck

tests.expected: 0 Threads.
tests.fails: It costs Threads.
tests.planb: Exclude it from the ARCANA_WEAVING check.
tests.steps: While Overloaded in combat, look at Emotional Overload's cost and cast it.
tests.title: Emotional Overload costs no Threads

title: The Resonant after the refining (R49-R68)
